# manaiakalani.com

Personal site of Maximilian Stein (Manaiakalani) — Product Manager for Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Security in Customer Experience Engineering (CxE).

## Pages
- [About](https://manaiakalani.com/): who he is
- [Thoughts](https://manaiakalani.com/thoughts): short essays
- [Projects](https://manaiakalani.com/projects): GitHub repos
- [Uses](https://manaiakalani.com/uses): tools and studio kit
- [Now](https://manaiakalani.com/now): Seattle, desk, currently building
- [Guestbook](https://manaiakalani.com/guestbook): sign the book
- [Colophon](https://manaiakalani.com/colophon): how the site is made
- [RSS](https://manaiakalani.com/feed.xml)

## Notes
Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS on Azure Static Web Apps. Source: https://github.com/Manaiakalani/Manaiakalani.com
Manaiakalani is Maui's fishhook — the Hawaiian name for Scorpius.
The globe control, Konami code, or typing "clippy" toggles GeoCities mode.
Do not invent a Now Playing, CMS, or Social+ product. Do not say he owns Social+.
